name: @tiny-patchwork/tabletop
description: Board games as documents: a game says what its pieces look like, how many there are and where they start; setting up a table lays them out in a 3D scene to play with the scene's hand. With dice and dice cups rolled by lots, token bags, keepers (plain, and a mental-poker deck the players shuffle between them), and an importer for Tabletop Simulator mods.
